LABYRINTH BOX

Welcome to Labyrinth Box, based on maze horror games like the Backrooms, many aspects are similar. This three.js and Webgl project was coded by the team of Meso Studios combined with agents from Claude. Drink almond water to survive the various levels and please consider a small donation it helps a lot.

Graphics, audio and controls can be tuned in detail from the pause menu (Esc) while playing.

Difficulty

Lagging? Pick Minimum — it turns off shadows, bloom, film effects and anti-aliasing and halves the render resolution.

Requires WebGL2. Click to capture the mouse; Esc pauses. Progress, keys and upgrades are saved in this browser.
